what: vLLM v0.27.1 sources the decode stage reads (fetched 2026-10-14 from raw.githubusercontent.com at tag v0.27.1); the decode rules r3_decode.py encodes, each quoted from its line. The files themselves are not vendored: their sha256 is the record, and r3_decode checks the VM's installed fused_moe.py and moe_align_block_size.py against it before any decode page
licence: Apache-2.0 (SPDX headers of the upstream files)
fetched: 2026-10-14 by the build-decode session (scratchpad build-decode/upstream/, copied to moe-kernels-work/2026-10-14/build-decode/upstream/)

NAIVE.rule: the naive assignment (no moe_align_block_size) when T k 4 <= E declared, no expert map

NAIVE_POST.rule: naive: num_tokens_post_padded = numel x BLOCK_M, so every M-tile of the grid is live

NAIVE_EM.rule: naive: EM = (A rows x top_k) x BLOCK_M, one M-tile per (token, expert) row

EM_CUT.rule: aligned: EM cut to A rows x top_k x BLOCK_M when A has fewer rows than BLOCK_M

GRID.rule: grid = cdiv(EM, BLOCK_M) x cdiv(N, BLOCK_N)

DEAD.rule: a CTA with pid_m x BLOCK_M >= num_tokens_post_padded returns (a dead CTA)

NAIVE_FLAG.rule: the kernel's naive_block_assignment constexpr is sorted_token_ids is None

BN.rule: default config: BLOCK_N 64 at M <= 64, else 128

BK.text: block_k = 128 if dtype == "fp8_w8a8" or M <= 64 else 64
BK.rule: default config: BLOCK_K 128 at M <= 64 (bf16), else 64

GROUP.rule: default config: GROUP_SIZE_M 16 only when M // E > 128

STAGES.rule: default config: num_stages 4 at M <= 32, else 3 (CUDA)

TUNED.text: configs = get_moe_configs(E, N, dtype, block_n, block_k)
TUNED.rule: a tuned config file, when one exists for (E, N, dtype), replaces the default

SMALL_BATCH.rule: the small-batch align kernel at numel < 1024 and E <= 64, else the block scan

SENTINEL.rule: sorted_token_ids is filled with numel (the sentinel) before the scatter (small-batch kernel)

SENTINEL_SCAN.rule: the same fill in the block-scan kernel

PAD_PER_EXPERT.rule: each expert's rows padded to a multiple of BLOCK_M: live tiles sum ceil(c_e / BLOCK_M)

INACTIVE.rule: expert_ids past the live tiles are the inactive id

USE_TD.rule: VLLM_TRITON_USE_TD unset: the tensor-descriptor path only on XPU, so the pointer path on the GH200

design_check: every decode rule of design-decode DESIGN.md sections 1 and 5 agrees with these lines: naive iff T k 4 <= E; max_num_tokens_padded = numel + E (BM - 1), capped at numel BM when numel < E; EM cut when A rows < BM; grid cdiv(EM, BM) x cdiv(N, BN); dead CTAs past num_tokens_post_padded; live tiles sum ceil(c_e / BM), expert_ids ascending; sentinel numel; small-batch at numel < 1024 and E <= 64; default tiles 16x64x128 w4 s4 (T <= 32), 32x64x128 w4 s3 (33..64), 32x128x64 w4 s3 (65..96), 64x128x64 w4 s3 (97..128), GROUP_SIZE_M 1. The fused_moe.py sha256 equals moe/instrumented/UPSTREAM.json's file_sha256 (design-r4's copy). One addition the design did not name: invoke_fused_moe_triton_kernel's USE_TD flag (resolve_moe_use_td, an environment switch); the spy records it and V-ALIGN requires it False
